corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This Federal Reserve policy record documents the final tightening phase of the 2015-2018 hiking cycle and the transition to a patient stance. The rate level of 2.25-2.50% and the January 2019 'patience' signal foreshadowed the 2019 rate cuts. For market structure analysis, this shows how the FOMC communicated policy shifts during a period of shifting risk sentiment.
corrected_fields.macro_context: The report documents a pivot in Fed policy from continued tightening in late 2018 to a patient, wait-and-see posture in early 2019. This occurred amid slowing global growth, muted inflation pressures, and heightened trade tensions. The policy shift preceded the easing actions taken later in 2019.
